directive.quote: If this is the ordinary same-owner extraction needed to express genuine existing single-source lineage, carry out the exact copy-before-adapt refactor in its real owner with truthful baseline/retirement/source ranges and coupled six manifest entries, preserving peer derive behavior and every consumer.

preserve: The original allocation-aware BLAKE3 class, compression loop, per-hasher scratch and destroy cleanup
The complete original MIT attribution and Noble tree, keyed, context, clone and XOF delegation
allowed_deltas: Move the exact existing compressor into its own module inside the canonical content-identity owner; the identity API imports and re-exports it
Namespace retains its checkpoint-specific wrappers and consumes the canonical identity API
banned_substitutions: A rewritten compressor, altered digest or second active compression implementation after integration
An archival artifact supplying active retention or invented source-first chronology
A different algorithm, weaker memory bound or relaxed dependency rights

required_mechanisms: export const blake3 = createHasher(opts => new AllocationAwareBLAKE3(opts))
